aboutParagraphs: Old Settlers' Park in Round Rock is one of the Austin metro's most-loved courses — a championship-quality layout with long, thoughtful par 4s and an open, rolling parkland feel. From the main tees it plays 6,617 feet at par 61.

The course is the anchor of Round Rock's disc golf scene, with the kind of design that rewards placement and patience over raw power. The long par 4s are the heart of the round — holes 12, 15, 16, and 17 are where the scorecard gets decided.
A proper Austin-area destination course: free, friendly, and good enough to draw players from across the metro.

signatureHoleDescription: Hole 17 is the longest at Old Settlers' Park at 628 feet — a par 4 that captures the course's championship character: a long, thoughtful drive, a precise approach, and a finish that rewards the patient player. It's the hole that decides most rounds and the one the locals measure themselves against.
localTips: The long par 4s on the back nine are where rounds are decided — pace yourself. Free to play (reportedly pay-to-play at times — verify the current fee policy before you go). A destination course for the Austin metro.
